rationale: The short thesis remains mechanically intact — price is below both the 9-EMA ($53.49) and session VWAP ($54.10), the stock has faded a ~6% gap-and-fade from the open on 4.87x relative volume, and the recent pullback stalls are on declining volume (317, 399, 979 shares), which reads as consolidation rather than reversal.
